encounter_rewrites.title: The Clock Strikes
encounter_rewrites.body: The Doomsday Clock strikes midnight, not with a chime but with a silent server shutdown. There are no more options left in the global menu; only fire remains as the final syntax of statecraft. The Politburo dissolves into static. The Mahdi does not appear on screens or servers. He manifests in the heat of the reactor core.
reaction_rewrites: The Wali's last fatwa is transmitted by emergency broadcast: 'The Mahdi is not in the servers. He is in the fire.' The signal cuts through the noise, a final theological assertion that code cannot contain divinity.
